messages:
ruby_sales: Heads-up: OakLoop signed an MSA and wants a 3-week POC. Theyll bring a custom 13B QLoRA variant and need EU-only residency + BYOK. Main asks: can we do a fast Dedicated onboarding or will Private be required?
ivan_ops: Dedicated eu-west is usually faster for short POCs. Private gives stronger legal posture for BYOK/HSM but slower. Depends on whether their adapter needs native ops.
mei_eng: Technical checklist: adapter tar.gz, base model name, tokenizer files, example prompts, any custom CUDA ops. If RMSNorm or a patched op is present we may need to build a custom runtime image.
ruby_sales: They said the adapter uses a small custom RMSNorm patch. How big of a blocker is that?
mei_eng: Small patch usually OK on Dedicated if we can build and deploy a custom operator layer; adds ~3-5 business days. If they insist on HSM-managed keys + on-prem HSM, Private is simpler.
nora_security: Security items: BYOK flow + KMS rotation policy, VPC peering/IP allowlist, EU data residency SLA, and an incoming vendor security questionnaire. I can own the questionnaire. Also need point of contact for their compliance team.
nash_prod: Proposed catalog entry for POC:
```
catalog_id: custom/oakloop/13b-qlora-poc
deployment: dedicated-eu-west-1
quant_profile: qlora-int8 (fallback q4)
runtime: continuous_batching=true, kv_cache=true, streaming=true
canary: oakloop-poc-canary
```
Route traffic to canary pool and enable perf logging.
ivan_ops: Perf estimate: with 3xA100-80GB and int8, p95 for ~1.2k tokens ~160-210ms. If they need 2k tokens and <200ms we should recommend 4 nodes or q4 tuning. Will run microbench on staging.
ruby_sales: Pricing question: they want a POC quote (3 weeks) with ~40k gen tokens/day and two load tests. Any quick numbers?
ivan_ops: Suggest: one-time setup $6k (VPC/BYOK/config), reserved mini-pool $2.5k/week, usage billed at dedicated rates. I'll draft a compact quote.
mei_eng: Action items: 1) Ruby to obtain adapter + tokenizer + sample prompts (today). 2) Mei to run adapter compatibility scan (48h). 3) Ivan to spin staging perf harness and provide p95 table (72h). 4) Nora to draft security questionnaire responses (48h).
task-bot: Ticket created: POC-2147 OakLoop onboarding (assignees: ivan_ops, mei_eng, nora_security)
ruby_sales: Thanks team  I'll set up a kickoff with their infra lead tomorrow. If the compatibility scan flags native ops we may switch to Private and update timelines. :thumbsup:
